description: This file declares the WiFiManager class, which implements a plugin for managing WiFi connections via JSONRPC in the WPEFramework. It includes method declarations for WiFi operations, event handlers, and interface implementations.

classes.name: WiFiManager
classes.description: A plugin class for WiFi management that supports JSONRPC communication, handling WiFi states, scanning, connection, and event notifications.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Gets the SSID of the currently connected network.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a specified WiFi network.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current WiFi network.

methods.name: saveSSID
methods.description: Saves an SSID for future connection.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Gets information about the paired SSID.

methods.name: isPaired
methods.description: Checks if the device is paired.
